PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref No: DS/GFG/L&L/05/133 Ministry of Lands & Land Development Ref No:

4-3/16/2018/UD/457 I hereby give notice, under Sub-section(1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No.28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below for a public purpose.

Description of the Land to be acquired: The allotments of land in total extent of 0.0029 hectare depicted in sheet No. 30 of Block No. 02 of Cadastral Map No. 810024 as lot Nos. 1077,1078 prepared by Survey General situated in village of Deddugoda in Grama Niladhari Division No. 101 A, Deddugoda South, within Municipal Council limit of Galle in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Four Gravets Galle in District of Galle , Southern Province. The names and extents of above named lots are as follows :
1. Lot No. : 1077 Name of the land : Mahamoragodawaththa,; assessment number - not known; Description: Home
garden, a part of a boundary wall ; Claimant : State; Original Claimant : D.P.Y. Gamage; Extent : about 0.0015 hectare.

2. Lot No.: 1078 Name of the land : Mahamoragodawaththa, assessment number – 118/4, Hirimbura cross road; Description: Home garden, a part of a boundary wall; Claimant : State; Original Claimant : Batapola Gamage Udaya Kasun; Extent : about 0.0014 hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/ servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat – Galle Four Gravets on 23.12.2019 at 9.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 16.12.2019, nature of their interests in the land/ lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. I. HIMALI RATHNAWEERA, Divisional Secretary, Galle Four Gravets. At Divisional Secretary’s Office, Galle - Four Gravets. 06th December 2019

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

04. Lot No. : 427 Name of the land : Kurunduwaththapashawulaovita, Pashawulaovita alias Kurunduwaththaaddara Mahaliyadda, Wallambagalaelaaddaraovita and and Kukalaneovita.; Description: Home garden and mix cultivation; Claimant : State; Original Claimant: Could not be traced; Extent: about 0.0020 hectare

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/ servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat – Galle Four Gravets on 23.12.2019 at 9.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 16.12.2019, the nature of their interests in the land/ lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
I. HIMALI RATHNAWEERA, Divisional Secretary, Galle Four Gravets. At Divisional Secretary’s Office, Galle - Four Gravets. 06th December 2019
